_about: Hit and juggle feel numbers (docs/pivot/combat_api.md 4.2). Starting guesses; the feel knobs scale the big ones live.

follow_jump._attack_after_ms: One-button combo: after the follow-jump starts, the air attack begins this many ms later (near the top of the jump).

hit_freeze._about: Tuning v1.3 (Ross: chunky hits). The freeze on impact. Each move's own hit_stop_ms (moves.json) is its freeze in ms when the F12 knob `hit_freeze_s` sits at reference_s; the knob scales every freeze by hit_freeze_s / reference_s. So the knob reads as 'how long the heaviest hits freeze', in seconds. Light hits are about 0.10 s and heavy hits, finishers, launchers and the guard break about 0.25 s at the default.
